personalInfo.name: Lin Chen
personalInfo.title: AI Application Engineer
personalInfo.summary: Builds AI products from ambiguous requirements through interface design, implementation, testing, and delivery. Comfortable connecting browser applications, agent workflows, model APIs, desktop runtimes, and production feedback loops.

description: Translated product goals into executable milestones spanning web, desktop, API, account, billing, and release work.
Built model-assisted workflows with explicit task states, recoverable tool calls, and user-visible validation.
Established browser tests and release checks around the paths most likely to lose user data or produce incorrect exports.
Worked directly with product feedback, reproduced failures, and verified fixes in the shipped interaction path.
Submitted focused pull requests with reproducible evidence and maintained compatibility with existing project conventions.
Reviewed interface and integration behavior across TypeScript, React, Rust, and local automation code.
Documented technical decisions so maintainers could verify data flow, failure boundaries, and release impact.
Coursework and projects covered interactive media, frontend engineering, product prototyping, and visual communication.

projects.name: Agent Workspace
description: Designed a desktop workspace that discovers agent capabilities, connects tools, and keeps task state visible to the user.
Implemented cross-platform flows across React, TypeScript, Rust, Tauri, local persistence, and process integration.
Added validation for configuration changes, provider responses, and browser-visible behavior before release.

projects.name: Storyboard Production Platform
description: Planned and delivered a commercial storyboard workflow covering the marketing site, web editor, desktop application, backend, accounts, and paid membership.
Turned production steps into observable states so users can inspect generation progress, revise outputs, and recover interrupted work.
Balanced model cost, interaction latency, operational scope, and first-release constraints while retaining the complete customer journey.

projects.name: Local Resume Builder
description: Built a local-first resume editor with structured data, real-time canvas preview, vector PDF export, and continuous PNG export.
Kept import, preview, and exported artifacts on one normalized data path with deterministic pagination and embedded fonts.
Added multilingual controls, accessible editor states, offline caching, and browser-level export verification.

projects.name: Developer Workflow CLI
description: Created a command-line workflow for repeatable local exports and predictable output paths.
Separated trusted loopback execution from explicit remote-builder use and surfaced boundary errors at the command entry point.
Covered argument parsing and artifact generation with unit and browser tests.

projects.name: Web3 Storage Explorer
description: Presented chain-backed storage records through a task-focused web interface and clear transaction states.
Mapped asynchronous wallet and network failures into messages users could act on without exposing internal details.
Used typed data boundaries and browser tests to keep the interface aligned with contract responses.
